text: わたし　ひとりか……　はー　さみしいな　ねえ　もっと　がんばって　みんなを　ふりむかせてよ！

structure.jp: ねえ　もっと　がんばって
みんなを　ふりむかせてよ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending on a verb means making someone else do it. ふりむかせて = 'make them turn around'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: Ending a sentence on the て-form is a casual way of asking someone to do something, short for てください. ふりむかせてよ = 'make them turn around, will you!'

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: がんばって　みんなを　ふりむかせて
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. がんばって　みんなを　ふりむかせて = 'try hard and make everyone turn around'.
